C2.note: 220 uF 16 V 6.3x7 2.5 mm 105 C (fits the 6.3x11 footprint)

D5.note: 1N4148W (Panjit), SOD-123; the symbol is Diode:MMSD4148 (same SOD-123 pinout), value 1N4148W

F1.note: 5x20 1 A time-lag glass (TBC1100A out of stock)

K1.note: replaces HJR-3FF-S-Z-4/05VDC (SRD type, 1500 VAC coil-contact) - owner decision 2026-11-21: reinforced 5 kV / 10 mm; MPQ 20. Second source on the same footprint: Hongfa HF115FD/005-1H3A(335), stock 93,169, 0.84704 USD at 50+ (https://www.ozdisan.com/p/genel-tip-roleler-403/hongfa-hf115fd-005-1h3a335-979825)

PS1.note: Ozdisan stock fell to 26 (333 on 2026-11-12), no incoming stock listed, lead time 7-8 weeks; fallback for a larger batch: LCSC (C403745, 4,433 pcs, 3.27 USD at 1 pc, https://www.lcsc.com/product-detail/C403745.html)

Q2,Q3.note: S8050 not stocked; MMBT4401 600 mA 40 V NPN SOT-23, same pinout

R4.note: R4 0402 -> 0603 1/10 W (2026-11-21): TRIG held on during a burst runs it continuously, up to 49 mW at 85 C

U5.note: MOC3052X -> MOC3083X (owner decision 2026-11-21): 800 V zero-cross; no 800 V random-phase driver stocked. X = VDE-approved version (Isocom DE93284 p.7)

U6.note: value field aligned to the purchased AHC part (was SN74LVC1G14DBVR on the symbol, 2026-11-21)

RN1-RN7.note: 33 R -> 100 R (EMC fix 2026-11-21): 150 R 0402x4 (4D02WGJ0151TCE) not stocked; 100 R is the nearest stocked value in the same 0402x4 footprint

100nF_0402.note: one 50 V X7R part for every 100 nF 0402 position (C5,C6,C8, C112-C115,C117-C119,C123,C126,C223,C225,C226, C129,C332)

10uF_0805.note: 10 V X5R used for both the 6.3 V (C116,C122,C336) and 10 V (C124,C127,C330,C331) positions

C125.note: 4.7 uF 50 V X5R instead of 25 V X7R (no 25 V X7R 0805 in stock; the 50 V rating gives better DC bias)

C221,C222.note: X7R 10 % instead of C0G 1 % (no 10 nF C0G 0603 in stock); thermocouple input filter, DC measurement, acceptable

C333,C334.note: 22 uF 16 V X5R (10 V X5R not in stock)

FCLIP.note: 5x20 PCB fuse clip, 4 per board (not in the schematic; clip pin diameter vs the 1.3 mm footprint holes to be confirmed)

L12.note: 2.2 uH PCD0403 not stocked; L12 changed to 10 uH PCD0403MT100 (same part as L11, same footprint): pi-filter corner 34 kHz -> 16 kHz, DCR 182 mOhm at ~0.3 A = 55 mV, Isat 1.04 A OK

R122,R123.note: the only 18 R 0805 in stock is the 0.1 % thin-film part

R132.note: 0.5 R 1 % 0.5 W 1206 (HP series); Uniohm RR1206J050KT5E 5 % 0.25 W is the cheaper alternative (0.046 USD)

R331.note: 10 k 0.1 % 25 ppm thin film instead of 1 % thick film: on 2026-11-23 every 10 k 1 % 0402 at Ozdisan is at zero stock (CQ02WGF1002TCE, 0402WGF1002TCE, RC0402FR-0710KL, AC0402FR-0710KL, RC1005F103CS, RK73H1ETTP1002F); same footprint, tighter tolerance, +0.05 USD per board

HS1.note: bought from Demsay (demsay.com, Fischer Elektronik distributor), owner decision 2026-11-23; the link is Demsay's Fischer page, not a product page, and Demsay's price, stock and minimum were not looked up (owner's instruction). The price shown is the DigiKey price of 2026-11-23 (5496-SK40963,5STCTO220-ND, 2.60 USD), used as an estimate. 5.6 K/W natural convection; clip-mounted version: Q1 is held by the Fischer retaining spring THF 409 TO 220 (own BOM line), with thermal compound
HS1.avail_text: Demsay: price and stock not checked

TCPROBE.note: K-type, M6 ring-terminal tip, 1 m fibreglass/SS-braid lead, 0-600 C, bare ends; 147.29 TL + KDV = 2.91 USD at 50.57 TL/USD (2026-11-23); web stock shows '10+', ask Motorobit for a larger batch; Motorobit SKU SNS.SCK.01.000085

C6.note: C6 100 nF -> 1 uF: ESP32 EN RC per Espressif (10k + 1 uF), decided 2026-11-13

D6.note: replaces RV2 (TVR10561K MOV) across the triac: 1 kV surge clamp 620 V (EMC fix 2026-11-21)

RV3.note: RV3 moved across the K1 contact, 300 V ac class (16 % margin to 253 V ac); MPQ 200. No thermally protected varistor stocked at Özdisan (Littelfuse TMOV14/20 all 0)

SPRINGF.note: SMD contact finger, 7.5 mm free height, hand-soldered last on the back landing pads; 8 per board = recommended contact set BP1, 6, 8, 10, 11, 13, 15, 16 (minimum set is 6: without BP8, BP16); reel of 700; the bench test of this finger is still open, so the quantity is provisional

DS1.note: 7 inch 800x480 24-bit RGB panel with GT911 capacitive touch, box of 60; Ozdisan has 61 in stock, no incoming stock and no lead time shown

FPCFER.note: NOT at Ozdisan; DigiKey 1934-1266-ND, one-piece flat-cable core, material 43, two in series on the TFT tail (owner decision 2026-11-23: the single large core 2643166551, 45 x 12.5 x 29 mm and 71 g, is too bulky and heavy). Each 26.5 x 6.6 x 12 mm, 8.2 g, opening 21.1 x 1.35 mm for the 20.5 mm tail (0.3 mm spare per side), typical 71 / 119 ohm at 100 / 250 MHz (Fair-Rite datasheet), so about 142 / 238 ohm for the pair against the 150 ohm from 100 MHz assumed in the simulations. Fit in the tail pocket of frame v2 and of the glass front is NOT checked. The owner orders DigiKey parts through ekomponent; this is the only DigiKey line (owner decision 2026-11-23)

HSCLIP.note: bought from Demsay together with the heatsink (owner decision 2026-11-23); Fischer's retaining spring for the SK 409 / SK 459 profiles, TO-220. Demsay's price, stock and minimum were not looked up; the price shown is the DigiKey price of 2026-11-23 (5496-THF409TO220-ND, 0.14 USD, minimum 100 there), used as an estimate
HSCLIP.avail_text: Demsay: price and stock not checked

HSCOMP.note: white silicone thermal compound, 100 g jar, between Q1 and HS1 (owner decision 2026-11-23, instead of a pad: Q1's tab is insulated). One jar is counted per batch (enough for 100 boards and more); the Ozdisan page gives no thermal conductivity

PESCREW.note: M3 x 8 hex-socket cap screw, black, inserted from the PCB back through J5. Chosen for its head diameter (DIN 912: 5.5 mm, inside the 5.6 mm bare seat; the Ozdisan pan-head screws are DIN 7985 with a head up to 6.0 mm). Its head is 3.0 mm high instead of the 2.4 mm in the first requirement: about 1.6 mm to the Formex sheet and 2.0 mm to the panel back. Head dimensions are the standard's, not stated on the Ozdisan page

PENUT.note: M3 hex nut on the front, on top of the washers

PEFLW.note: M3 flat washer, 0.53 mm, zinc-plated steel, on top of the ring lug

PESPRW.note: M3 spring washer, stainless, 3.0 / 5.2 mm; the locking element under the nut

PELUG3.note: red insulated ring terminal for 0.5-1.5 mm2, ring 5.7 mm wide, 17.8 mm long, hole 3.7 mm (M3.5), used on the M3 screw of J5 with the tongue at 150 degrees. The exact M3 size L-KLS8-01103-RV1.25-3 (hole 3.2 mm) is out of stock (1,000 incoming, 5-6 weeks): https://www.ozdisan.com/p/yuvarlak-tip-konnektorler-344/kls-electronic-l-kls8-01103-rv1-25-3-531584

PELUG4.note: red insulated ring terminal for 0.5-1.5 mm2, ring 6.6 mm wide, 20.1 mm long, hole 4.3 mm (M4), on chassis stud FH9; 125 in stock. How it is held on FH9 (second M4 nut or under the existing nut) is still open and no M4 nut is listed

PELEAD.note: bought from a local electrical supplier (owner decision 2026-11-23), no link; flexible single-core PVC lead, 1 mm2, green/yellow, fits the red 0.5-1.5 mm2 ring terminals. About 60 mm per board; the order quantity is in whole metres. Price is an estimate: about 10 TL per metre seen on a price-comparison site, not verified. A linked alternative is Alpha Wire 3055 GY005 at DigiKey (18 AWG, 30.5 m spool, 123.75 USD)

PCBSCREW.note: pan-head self-tapping screw, cross recess, stainless A2, into the nine frame bosses under H1-H9 (blind 2.4 mm pilots, 0.3-0.4 Nm), as specified for frame v2 and the glass front (spec 12.11). Not at Ozdisan (its tapping screws are 2.2 x 6.5, PT 3 x 14 and 2.9 x 40 only) and no DigiKey part found (DigiKey's site showed a bot check), so it is a local purchase with no link. Price is an estimate from a 100-piece pack price seen online, not verified. The exact article exists at Wurth as ISO 7049-C A2 2.9 x 9.5: https://eshop.wuerth.de/Pan-head-tapping-screws-with-recessed-head-ISO-7049-A2-70-stainless-steel-plain-SCR-PANHD-ISO7049-C-A2-20H-H1-29X95/505122995.sku/en/US/EUR (page not opened by me; trade customers only)
